facts.fact: The BCEAO national director said the overall access rate to financial services in Guinea-Bissau rose from 20.5% in 2018 to 79.5% at end-2025, largely through electronic money.
The BCEAO national director said the overall access rate to financial services in Guinea-Bissau reached 79.5% at end-2025.

note: The rate is BCEAO's overall access rate, not stated to be a survey of adults.
